subject: planner: move BasePhysicalJoin related logic into physical op dir (#62571)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (single-parent commit). Change is a refactor: `basePhysicalJoin` is moved out of `pkg/planner/core/physical_plans.go` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/base_physical_join.go` as `physicalop.BasePhysicalJoin`, and join plans are updated to embed/call the new type. Internal helpers and interfaces are mechanically renamed from `getInnerChildIdx` to `GetInnerChildIdx` across probe-parent propagation/estimation paths. Plan-cache cloning support is updated: generator + generated clones now call `BasePhysicalJoin.CloneForPlanCacheWithSelf`, and `utilfuncp.CloneColumnsForPlanCache` is introduced and wired in `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go` so the moved code can reuse the existing cloning logic. No planner correctness/SQL-semantics/runtime/transaction/privilege behavior change detected; no remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched planner code.
